notes: 32 frozen cases for citation-format and pack-scope checking. Synthetic only.
Every question names the facts that must reach the pack (relevant) and the facts that must not (forbidden).
The checker runs the real memory pack builder offline: no model, no embedding. Final answers are not generated.
Holdout cases are not paraphrases of dev cases; each uses its own entity and facts.

categories.stable: same fact across turns, numeric or identifier answer
categories.replacement: older fact retired by a confirmed successor
categories.conflict: two active facts, ambiguity must stay visible
categories.no-answer: nothing in scope supports the question
categories.cross-language: question language differs from the fact language
categories.scope: same-name sibling or foreign workspace fact must not enter the pack
